#!/usr/bin/env nextflow

nextflow.enable.dsl=2

params.quilt = "/maps/projects/alab/people/rlk420/quilt2/ont/z-quilt2-ukb-v4.sh"
params.chroms =  ["chr1","chr2","chr3","chr4","chr5","chr6","chr7","chr8","chr9","chr10","chr11","chr12","chr13","chr14","chr15","chr16","chr17","chr18","chr19","chr20","chr21","chr22"]
params.ncores = 1

params.sample_csv = "data/giab.samples.csv"
params.outdir = "scratch/bench-force-calling"
params.fasta = "/maps/projects/alab/people/rlk420/quilt2/ont/data/resources/human_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fasta"
params.repeats = "/maps/projects/alab/people/rlk420/quilt2/ont/data/resources/human_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.trf.bed"
params.sv_vcf = "/maps/projects/alab/scratch/zilong/Platinum-Pedigree-Datasets/merged_hg38.svs.TRexclusion.sort.oa.vcf.gz"
params.bed = "/maps/projects/alab/people/rlk420/quilt2/ont/data/giab/GRCh38_HG2-T2TQ100-V1.0_stvar.noXY.benchmark.bed"
params.single = false
params.bench = true
params.hifi = false
params.fig_title = "'Force Calling'"


log.info """\
         R N A S E Q - N F   P I P E L I N E
         ===================================
         sample_csv:    ${params.sample_csv}
         sv_vcf:    ${params.sv_vcf}
         reference:    ${params.fasta}
         repeats:    ${params.repeats}
         hifi:    ${params.hifi}
         """
         .stripIndent()


process MergeLabels {
    publishDir "${params.outdir}/quilt2/${id}", mode: 'copy'
    cache false
    
    input:
    tuple val(id), path(bam), path(bai), val(labels)

    output:
    tuple val(id), path("all.label.txt")

    script:
    """
    txts=(${labels.join(' ')})
    for i in \${!txts[@]};do awk -v id=\$((i+1)) '{print \$1,\$2,id}' \${txts[i]};done > all.label.txt
    """
}

// install the forked version of cuteSV2: https://github.com/Zilong-Li/cuteSV
process SVUPP_cuteSV2 {
    publishDir "${params.outdir}/SVUPP_cuteSV2", mode: 'copy'
    
    input:
    path vcf
    tuple val(id), path(bam), path(bai), path(label)

    output:
    tuple val(id), path("${id}.vcf.gz"), path("${id}.vcf.gz.tbi"), path("${id}.time")

    script:
    """
    mkdir -p outdir
    source /maps/projects/alab/people/rlk420/software/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
    conda activate svupp
    if [ ${params.hifi} == true ];then \
        /usr/bin/time -v  cuteSV $bam ${params.fasta} ${id}.vcf outdir -S ${id} -t 6 --max_cluster_bias_INS 1000 --diff_ratio_merging_INS 0.9 --max_cluster_bias_DEL 1000 --diff_ratio_merging_DEL 0.5 --min_support 1 -Ivcf ${vcf} -read_hap1_prob ${label} &> ${id}.time
    else \
        /usr/bin/time -v  cuteSV $bam ${params.fasta} ${id}.vcf outdir -S ${id} -t 6 --max_cluster_bias_INS 100 --diff_ratio_merging_INS 0.3 --max_cluster_bias_DEL 100 --diff_ratio_merging_DEL 0.3 --min_support 1 -Ivcf ${vcf} -read_hap1_prob ${label} &> ${id}.time
    fi
    bcftools sort ${id}.vcf -o ${id}.vcf.gz
    tabix ${id}.vcf.gz
    """
}

process cuteSV2 {
    publishDir "${params.outdir}/cuteSV2", mode: 'copy'
    
    input:
    path vcf
    tuple val(id), path(bam), path(bai), path(label)

    output:
    tuple val(id), path("${id}.vcf.gz"), path("${id}.vcf.gz.tbi"), path("${id}.time")

    script:
    """
    mkdir -p outdir
    source /maps/projects/alab/people/rlk420/software/miniforge3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
    conda activate base
    if [ ${params.hifi} == true ];then \
        /usr/bin/time -v cuteSV $bam ${params.fasta} ${id}.vcf outdir -S ${id} -t 6 --max_cluster_bias_INS 1000 --diff_ratio_merging_INS 0.9 --max_cluster_bias_DEL 1000 --diff_ratio_merging_DEL 0.5  --min_support 1 -Ivcf ${vcf} &> ${id}.time
    else \
        /usr/bin/time -v cuteSV $bam ${params.fasta} ${id}.vcf outdir -S ${id} -t 6 --max_cluster_bias_INS 100 --diff_ratio_merging_INS 0.3 --max_cluster_bias_DEL 100 --diff_ratio_merging_DEL 0.3  --min_support 1 -Ivcf ${vcf} &> ${id}.time
    fi
    bcftools sort ${id}.vcf -o ${id}.vcf.gz
    tabix ${id}.vcf.gz
    """
}

process Sniffles2 {
    publishDir "${params.outdir}/Sniffles2", mode: 'copy'
    
    input:
    path vcf
    tuple val(id), path(bam), path(bai), path(label)

    output:
    tuple val(id), path("${id}.vcf.gz"), path("${id}.vcf.gz.tbi"), path("${id}.time")

    script:
    """
        /usr/bin/time -v sniffles \
        --input ${bam} \
        --genotype-vcf ${vcf} \
        --vcf ${id}.vcf \
        --threads 6 \
        --tandem-repeats ${params.repeats} \
        --allow-overwrite &> ${id}.time
    echo ${id} > header
    bcftools reheader -s header ${id}.vcf | bcftools sort -o ${id}.vcf.gz
    tabix ${id}.vcf.gz
    """
}

process Kanpig {
    publishDir "${params.outdir}/kanpig", mode: 'copy'
    
    input:
    path vcf
    tuple val(id), path(bam), path(bai), path(label)

    output:
    tuple val(id), path("${id}.vcf.gz"), path("${id}.vcf.gz.tbi"), path("${id}.time")

    script:
    """
        /usr/bin/time -v kanpig gt --input ${vcf} --reads ${bam} --reference ${params.fasta} --out ${id}.vcf --sample ${id} --threads 6 &> ${id}.time
    bcftools sort -W -o ${id}.vcf.gz ${id}.vcf
    tabix ${id}.vcf.gz
    """
}

process Merge {
    publishDir "${params.outdir}/${program}", mode: 'copy'

    input:
    val program
    path vcfs

    output:
    path("merge.vcf.gz*")

    script:
    """
    echo $vcfs | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -v tbi > vcfs.list
    bcftools merge -W -Oz -o merge.vcf.gz -l vcfs.list
    """
}

workflow SNIFFLES {
    take:
    svvcf
    bams

    main:
    Sniffles2(svvcf, bams)
    Merge("Sniffles2", Sniffles2.out.collect { v -> tuple(v[1], v[2]) }.view())

    emit:
    Merge.out
}

workflow CUTESV {
    take:
    svvcf
    bams

    main:
    cuteSV2(svvcf, bams)
    Merge("cuteSV2", cuteSV2.out.collect { v -> tuple(v[1], v[2]) }.view())

    emit:
    Merge.out
}

workflow SVUPP_C {
    take:
    svvcf
    bams

    main:
    SVUPP_cuteSV2(svvcf, bams)
    Merge("SVUPP_cuteSV2", SVUPP_cuteSV2.out.collect { v -> tuple(v[1], v[2]) }.view())

    emit:
    Merge.out
}

workflow KANPIG {
    take:
    svvcf
    bams

    main:
    Kanpig(svvcf, bams)
    Merge("kanpig", Kanpig.out.collect { v -> tuple(v[1], v[2]) }.view())

    emit:
    Merge.out
}

workflow {
    input_bams_ch = Channel.fromPath(params.sample_csv)
        .splitCsv()
        .map {row -> tuple("${row[0]}", "${row[1]}","${row[2]}", "${row[3]}")}
    svupp=SVUPP_C(params.sv_vcf, input_bams_ch)
    kanpig=KANPIG(params.sv_vcf, input_bams_ch)
    cute=CUTESV(params.sv_vcf, input_bams_ch)
    sniffle=SNIFFLES(params.sv_vcf, input_bams_ch)
}

workdir <- '/maps/projects/alab/people/mqr375/svupp/reproduceplot/'

# Load truth
truth_vcf <- vcfppR::vcftable(paste0(workdir, 'platinum.withdist1000.vcf.gz'))
truth_vcf$NumNeighbors <- vcfppR::vcfinfo(paste0(workdir, 'platinum.withdist1000.vcf.gz'),'NumNeighbors')$NumNeighbors

# Autosomes and random sample for unbiased cut in SVs with same GQ.
set.seed(1)
autosomes <- sample(which(truth_vcf$chr %in% paste0('chr', 1:22)))
truth_vcf$id <- truth_vcf$id[autosomes]
truth_vcf$NumNeighbors <- truth_vcf$NumNeighbors[autosomes]

# m x n matrix with genotypes. m SVs and n indvs.
truth <- truth_vcf$gt[autosomes,]
colnames(truth) <- truth_vcf$samples
rownames(truth) <- truth_vcf$id
diallelic <- truth_vcf$NumNeighbors == 0

# Read data
readMethod <- function(vcfpath){
    # This function takes a vcf path as input, reads the GT and GQ data
    # and outputs a list with gt and gq matched to the truth defined above.
    method_vcf <- vcfppR::vcftable(vcfpath)
    method_gq <- vcfppR::vcftable(vcfpath, format='GQ')
    SVstoTruth <- match(truth_vcf$id, method_vcf$id)
    SamplestoTruth <- match(truth_vcf$samples, method_vcf$samples)
    if(sum(!method_vcf$id[SVstoTruth] == truth_vcf$id)>0){stop('SV IDs do not match')}

    gt <- method_vcf$gt[SVstoTruth,SamplestoTruth]
    rownames(gt) <- method_vcf$id[SVstoTruth]
    colnames(gt) <- method_vcf$samples[SamplestoTruth]

    gq <- method_gq$GQ[SVstoTruth,SamplestoTruth]
    rownames(gq) <- method_vcf$id[SVstoTruth]
    colnames(gq) <- method_vcf$samples[SamplestoTruth]
    return(list('gt'=gt, 'gq'=gq, 'vcfpath'=vcfpath))
}

# Read the four methods and find discordance, as GT in method not equal GT in the truth.
sniffles <- readMethod(paste0(workdir,'sniffles2.vcf.gz'))
kanpig <- readMethod(paste0(workdir,'kanpig.vcf.gz'))
cute <- readMethod(paste0(workdir,'cuteSV2.vcf.gz'))
svupp <- readMethod(paste0(workdir,'svupp.vcf.gz'))
sniffles$disc <- sniffles$gt != truth
kanpig$disc <- kanpig$gt != truth
cute$disc <- cute$gt != truth
svupp$disc <- svupp$gt != truth

# All samples in one long vector
allGQrank <- function(gq, disc){
    gq[is.na(gq)] <- -1
    m <- sum(!is.na(disc))

    keep <- !is.na(disc)
    disc <- disc[keep]
    gq <- gq[keep]

    ord <- order(gq, decreasing = T)
    disc <- disc[ord]
    gq <- gq[ord]

    return(data.frame(
        'rankedmeandisc'=cumsum(disc)/1:m,
        'gq'=gq
    ))
}


# Rank all diallelic GT calls by GQ.
sniffles_all <- allGQrank(as.vector(sniffles$gq[diallelic,]),as.vector(sniffles$disc[diallelic,]))
kanpig_all <- allGQrank(as.vector(kanpig$gq[diallelic,]),as.vector(kanpig$disc[diallelic,]))
cute_all <- allGQrank(as.vector(cute$gq[diallelic,]),as.vector(cute$disc[diallelic,]))
svupp_all <- allGQrank(as.vector(svupp$gq[diallelic,]),as.vector(svupp$disc[diallelic,]))

# Plotting
cols <- c(
    'Sniffles2'='#999999',
    'kanpig'='#E69F00',
    'cuteSV2'='#56B4E9',
    'SVUPP'='#0072B2'
)

png('discordance_noneighbors_10X.png',
    width=3, height=3, res=300, units = 'in')
par(mar=c(2.5,3.3,1,0.7), mgp=c(1.6,0.6,0), font.main=1, cex.main=1)
plot(1,1,col='transparent',xlim=c(1e4,10e4), ylim=c(0,0.14), las=1, bty='L',
    main='No-neighbour SVs (depth=10X)', xlab='', ylab='', axes=F)
yticks <- axTicks(2)
axis(2, at=yticks, labels = paste0(yticks*100, '%'), las=1)
xticks <- axTicks(1)
axis(1, at=xticks, labels = xticks/10000, las=1)
axis(1, at=1e+4, labels=1)
xminor <- seq(1e4,2e5,by=1e4)
axis(1, at=xminor, labels = NA, las=1, tck=-0.02)
box(bty='L')
mtext(expression('Number of called genotypes (10'^4*')'), 1, line=1.7)
mtext('Mean genotype discordance',2, line=2.4)

pointcex <- 0.35
sniffles_gqchange <- c(which(sniffles_all$gq[-length(sniffles_all$gq)]>sniffles_all$gq[-1]), length(sniffles_all$gq))
sniffles_gqchange <- c(1e+04, sniffles_gqchange[sniffles_gqchange>1e+04])
lines(sniffles_gqchange, sniffles_all$rankedmeandisc[sniffles_gqchange], type='l', col=cols['Sniffles2'], lwd=1)
points(sniffles_gqchange, sniffles_all$rankedmeandisc[sniffles_gqchange], pch=19, col=cols['Sniffles2'], cex=pointcex)
kanpig_gqchange <- c(which(kanpig_all$gq[-length(kanpig_all$gq)]>kanpig_all$gq[-1]), length(kanpig_all$gq))
kanpig_gqchange <- c(1e+04, kanpig_gqchange[kanpig_gqchange>1e+04])
lines(kanpig_gqchange, kanpig_all$rankedmeandisc[kanpig_gqchange], type='l', col=cols['kanpig'], lwd=1)
points(kanpig_gqchange, kanpig_all$rankedmeandisc[kanpig_gqchange], pch=19, col=cols['kanpig'], cex=pointcex)
cute_gqchange <- c(which(cute_all$gq[-length(cute_all$gq)]>cute_all$gq[-1]), length(cute_all$gq))
cute_gqchange <- c(1e+04, cute_gqchange[cute_gqchange>1e+04])
lines(cute_gqchange, cute_all$rankedmeandisc[cute_gqchange], type='l', col=cols['cuteSV2'], lwd=1)
points(cute_gqchange, cute_all$rankedmeandisc[cute_gqchange], pch=19, col=cols['cuteSV2'], cex=pointcex)
svupp_gqchange <- c(which(svupp_all$gq[-length(svupp_all$gq)]>svupp_all$gq[-1]), length(svupp_all$gq))
svupp_gqchange <- c(1e+04, svupp_gqchange[svupp_gqchange>1e+04])
lines(svupp_gqchange, svupp_all$rankedmeandisc[svupp_gqchange], type='l', col=cols['SVUPP'], lwd=1)
points(svupp_gqchange, svupp_all$rankedmeandisc[svupp_gqchange], pch=19, col=cols['SVUPP'], cex=pointcex)


legend('bottom', legend = names(cols), col=cols, lwd=1, ncol=2, cex=0.9,
    pch=19, seg.len = 0.7, pt.cex = pointcex, bty='n', x.intersp = 0.5)

dev.off()
